hook: "I AM RICH"|THE MORE YOU SAY IT|THE FURTHER IT GOES

voices.name: l00
voices.text: I am rich. <#0.2#> Do you say it every day?
voices.caption: I am rich. Do you say it every day?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: While not believing a word inside?
voices.caption: While not believing a word inside?

voices.name: l02
voices.text: The more you force it, <#0.2#> the emptier you feel. Nothing changed.
voices.caption: The more you force it, the emptier you feel. Nothing changed.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: The real way <#0.3#> is to imagine joyfully.
voices.caption: The real way is to imagine joyfully.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: How it would feel to have it, <#0.2#> so good you could cry.
voices.caption: How it would feel to have it, so good you could cry.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: And then, <#0.2#> go live today well.
voices.caption: And then, go live today well.
